Under-construction wall collapse in Jaipur kills 3 workers, injures 12

A wall at an under-construction resort in Jaipur's Chandwaji area collapsed, resulting in the deaths of at least three workers and injuring twelve others. Several workers were feared trapped under the debris. Rescue operations were underway following the incident.
